name: hansharhoff-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills marketplace by Hans Harhoff Andersen

plugins.name: teach-tech
plugins.description: Interactive technology teaching sessions — guides you through new technologies with explanations, diagrams, and hands-on exercises

plugins.name: repo-cleanup
plugins.description: Audit and clean up a repository: find typos, inconsistencies, outdated references, dead code, failing tests, type errors, linter issues, and documentation gaps

plugins.name: spec-loop
plugins.description: Iterate code against an in-repo spec using pinned-commit-hash alignment (no copies). Six-step loop with opinionated deliverable shape (INTRO/SPEC/implementation) and HARD/AGREED/INCIDENTAL tier model. Repo-agnostic: defaults to `specs/`, override via `.spec-loop.toml`.

plugins.name: tailscale-served-dashboard
plugins.description: Turn a locally-running web app or dashboard on a Mac into a durable, tailnet-reachable service: bind 127.0.0.1, front it with tailscale serve (HTTPS), and supervise it with a launchd LaunchDaemon. Includes scaffold.sh to generate the run script, daemon plist, and installer.

plugins.name: whats-next
plugins.description: PM-style triage + capture for the active workspace. READ mode renders a ranked dashboard of open PRs, in-session tasks, scheduled memory items, Atlassian (when MCP available), git state, and circle-back notes — ≤ 80%-of-screen, ending with a one-line action prompt. CAPTURE mode catches phrases like 'remind me to' or 'let's circle back' and routes them to a task or a dated memory file.

plugins.name: agent-team-workflow
plugins.description: Run sub-agents alongside a warm main agent so the human's questions aren't blocked. Codifies the in-session strategy (when to dispatch vs do work in main) AND the mechanics (pre-dispatch git-status check, explicit branch convention, return contract, post-merge cleanup) for sub-Agent calls with isolation: 'worktree'. Avoids locked worktrees, uncommitted carry-over, and the 'agent reported completed but the CLI is still running' trap. Scope: a single Claude Code session.

plugins.name: nurse-prs
plugins.description: Drive a repo's open PRs (and related issues) to a landable state WITHOUT approving or merging: respond to review comments, validate changes end-to-end and post the evidence, keep every branch mergeable (resolve conflicts as siblings land), flip validated drafts to ready, triage related issues, and keep a persistent monitor up (bin/pr-watch.sh) so new activity is handled autonomously. Surfaces every merge/approve/design decision to the human as a crisp judgement ask. Scope: one repo's PR queue, ongoing across a session.

plugins.name: post-to-hansharhoff-blog
plugins.description: Publish or update posts on the hansharhoff.dk WordPress blog via the REST API. Handles auth (env var, local file, or a 1Password op:// reference), the site's incomplete TLS chain, and its bot-protection WAF. Credentials are never committed.

plugins.name: session-retro
plugins.description: Reflect on a Claude Code session and produce an honest retrospective one-pager: what went well/poorly (with lessons), techniques worth keeping, a token-hygiene grade (where /clear and /compact would have saved money, plus tips), a 'did we forget anything?' cross-check against the whats-next handoff/memory/tasks, and forward-looking suggestions (new skills, CLAUDE.md edits, how we work together). A deterministic analyzer digests the transcript so the model never reads the raw JSONL; output is delivered as a reviewable Artifact.

plugins.name: resumable-sessions
plugins.description: Make Claude Code sessions survive reboots, crashes, and accidentally closed terminals: hold them in tmux, recreate the layout from one idempotent bootstrap script that re-resumes each conversation with `claude --continue` (re-asserting the cwd and permission mode that --continue does not restore), and have the OS run that script at login AND every few minutes so recovery is self-healing. Per-platform supervisor notes (launchd / systemd user timer / Task Scheduler), a tested bootstrap template, and a manual-recovery cheatsheet for rescuing a single lost conversation.
